annotations.title: Open a template with the user's details on it

description: Make the link that opens one template from show_templates in the Designprint editor, with the user's own words in place of the template's sample text. Pass the template_id and the replacements. The user edits anything they like there and orders prints from the same page; nothing is charged by this call. If the result lists texts that were not placed, correct them and call it again.

channel.description: The assistant making the call, for example claude or chatgpt.

replacements.description: Which of the template's texts to replace with the user's own words. Texts left out stay as the template has them.

find.description: One of the template's texts, copied exactly from show_templates (same letters, spaces and line breaks).

text.description: What it should read instead. Keep the line breaks of a text that has several lines.

template_id.description: The template_id of the template the user picked, from show_templates.

name: open_template
title: Open a template with the user's details on it
